content: In order to try to explain the observed variation in our results depending on shows and gender (Figure FIGREF21), we add the notion of speech type to shed some light on our results. BIBREF22 and BIBREF24 suggested that the speaker professionalism, associated with clear and hyper-articulated speech could be an explaining factor for better performance.
